### 1 — Scene
A mixed meat plate with roast poultry, a bone-in roasted meat portion, bacon, a piece of baguette, and what appears to be a fresh rice-paper roll.

### 2 — Vessel
Likely a **26 cm dinner plate**, appearing oval because of the camera angle. Estimated area:  
**3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm².**

### 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
Meat identification is somewhat uncertain. The central bone-in portion looks like lamb or similar roasted meat.

| Visible item | Plate area | Area × average height = volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Roasted bone-in meat, edible portion | 15% | 80 cm² × 1.6 cm = 128 ml | 0.95 | 121 g | 230 | 278 kcal |
| White roast chicken meat | 5% | 27 cm² × 1.2 cm = 32 ml | 0.95 | 30 g | 165 | 50 kcal |
| Skin-on roast chicken | 10% | 53 cm² × 1.5 cm = 80 ml | 0.95 | 76 g | 250 | 190 kcal |
| Bacon strips/pieces | 11% | 58 cm² × 0.65 cm = 38 ml | 0.90 | 34 g | 450 | 153 kcal |
| Baguette piece | 15% | 80 cm² × 3 cm = 240 ml | 0.30 | 72 g | 270 | 194 kcal |
| Fresh rice-paper roll | 8% | 42 cm² × 1.6 cm = 68 ml | 0.70 | 48 g | 110 | 53 kcal |

No separate sauce or pooled oil is clearly visible; cooking fat and chicken skin are included in the relevant energy estimates.

### 4 — Coverage check
Edible food covers approximately **64%** of the plate. The exposed bone occupies roughly another **4%**, giving about **68% total coverage**. The bone is excluded from edible weight and energy.

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **381 g of edible food and 918 kcal** is plausible for the visible combination of meat, fatty skin/bacon, bread, and a small fresh roll. Identification and portion thickness introduce substantial uncertainty.
